data.titulo: Tasal 4—Chalen Keʼxkʼe li Xbʼeen Awabʼej Toj Naq Keʼkʼameʼk laj Israel Choʼq Moos
data.contenido:
Laj Saul kiwank choʼq xbʼeen awabʼej saʼ li tenamit Israel. Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ chik kiraj naq laj Saul t-awabʼejinq joʼkan naq kixsikʼ laj David choʼq reqaj. Aatinaqo chirix laj David. Toj saaj laj David naq kiyalok rikʼin jun li nimla winq, aj Goliat xkʼabʼaʼ. Joʼkan ajwiʼ laj David kiʼelelik chiru laj Saul xbʼaan naq xikʼ naʼileʼk. Li xʼAbigail inkʼaʼ kixkanabʼ naq laj David tixkamsi jun li winq.

Chirix chik aʼan, tootzoloq chirix laj Salomon. Laj Salomon kikanaak choʼq awabʼej re Israel naq kikamk li xyuwaʼ. Ebʼ li oxibʼ chi awabʼej li keʼwank xbʼeenwa, keʼawabʼejink 40 chihabʼ chixjunqalebʼ. Ak kamenaq laj Salomon naq li tenamit Israel kixjach ribʼ saʼ wiibʼ. Saʼ jun rehebʼ li tenamit kiwank 10 chi teep ut saʼ li jun chik tenamit kiwank 2 chi teep.

Ebʼ li 10 chi teep keʼwank 257 chihabʼ naq toj maajiʼ nekeʼsacheʼk xbʼaanebʼ laj Asirio. Naq kinumeʼk 133 chihabʼ keʼsacheʼk ajwiʼ ebʼ li wiibʼ chi teep. Aran naq, ebʼ laj Israel keʼkʼameʼk choʼq moos saʼ li tenamit Babilonia. Chixjunil li XKA Tasal kikʼulmank chiru 510 chihabʼ. Toj tqatzol xkomon li xninqal ru naʼlebʼ.

KʼE REETAL laj Samuel yook xkʼeebʼal aseeyt saʼ xjolom jun li winq. Aʼin nabʼaanumank re xkʼutbʼesinkil naq jun li winq sikʼbʼil ru choʼq awabʼej. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Samuel naq tixkʼe aseeyt saʼ xjolom laj Saul. Li aseeyt aʼin kʼajoʼ xsununkil xbʼook.

Laj Saul kixkʼoxla naq inkʼaʼ truuq chi awabʼejink. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Samuel: ‹Laaʼin ninchalk saʼ xteepal laj Benjamin. Jwal kachʼin ru linteep chiru xteepebʼ laj Israel. Kʼaʼut nakaaye naq tinkanaaq choʼq awabʼej?› Li Jehobʼa kiwulak chiru xnaʼlebʼ laj Saul, xbʼaan naq moko naraj ta naq tnimaaq xwankil. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixsikʼ ru choʼq awabʼej.

Laj Saul kʼajoʼ xchʼinaʼusal, najt roq chiruhebʼ laj Israel ut bʼihom. Nawulak chiru aanilak ut wank xmetzʼew. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼsahoʼk saʼ xchʼool naq li Jehobʼa kixsikʼ laj Saul choʼq awabʼej. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Sahaq taxaq saʼ xchʼool li awabʼej!›

Ak wank choʼq awabʼej laj Saul naq ebʼ laj Amon kohebʼ chi yalok saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel. Ebʼ laj Amon toj kawebʼ ribʼ chi yalok. Joʼkan naq laj Saul kixchʼutubʼ naabʼal aj Israel re naq teʼyaloq rikʼinebʼ laj Amon ut us keʼelk. Ebʼ laj Israel sahebʼ saʼ xchʼool naq laj Saul wank choʼq awabʼej.

Chiru naabʼal chihabʼ laj Saul kiwank choʼq awabʼej saʼ xyanqebʼ laj Israel ut us keʼelk saʼ li yalok. Laj Saul kiwank jun ralal, aj Jonatan xkʼabʼaʼ. Laj Jonatan kaw ribʼ chi yalok ut kixtenqʼahebʼ laj Israel chi yalok ut naabʼal sut keʼelk chiʼus. Saʼ jun kutan ebʼ laj Filisteo keʼchalk chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Israel xbʼaan naq toj yookebʼ xjosqʼil saʼ xbʼeenebʼ.

Laj Samuel kixye re laj Saul naq t-oybʼeeniiq saʼ li naʼajej Guilgal ut aran tmayejaq laj Samuel chiru li Jehobʼa. Abʼan kibʼayk chaq laj Samuel. Laj Saul kichalk xxiw xbʼaan naq naru nekeʼchalk laj Filisteo chi yalok saʼ xbʼeenebʼ, joʼkan naq kimayejak xjunes. Naq laj Samuel kiwulak rikʼin laj Saul kixye re: ‹Kʼaʼut inkʼaʼ xat-abʼink chiru li Jehobʼa? Anaqwan li Jehobʼa tixsikʼ jun chik li awabʼej re naq t-jolominq saʼ li tenamit Israel!›

Laj Saul kimaakobʼk wiʼ chik. Joʼkan naq laj Samuel kixye re: ‹Jwal loqʼ abʼink chiru li Jehobʼa chiru li mayejak. Xbʼaan naq inkʼaʼ xat-abʼink, li Jehobʼa tatrisi choʼq awabʼej›.

Chixjunil aʼin naxkʼut chiqu naq tento tooabʼinq chiru li Jehobʼa. Naqatzol ajwiʼ naq li chaabʼil xnaʼlebʼ naru naxpoʼ xnaʼlebʼ, joʼ kixkʼul chaq laj Saul. Us raj naq maajunwa tqakʼul aʼan!1 Samuel 9–11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samuel 1:23. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Li Yos Kixsikʼ Ru laj David
data.contenido:
KʼARU yook chi kʼulmank saʼ li eetalil? Li chʼinaʼal aʼin kixkol jun li karneer saʼ ruqʼ jun li oso. Li xul aʼin kixkʼam jun li chʼina karneer. Joʼkan naq li chʼinaʼal kixtochʼ li oso ut kixkol li karneer. Naq li oso kiwakli, li chʼinaʼal kixkamsi. Kixkol ajwiʼ jun li karneer saʼ ruqʼ jun li kaqkoj. Kaw ribʼ li chʼinaʼal. Abʼan, ma nakaanaw ani li chʼinaʼal aʼin?

Li chʼinaʼal aʼan laj David ut Belen kiyoʼlaak chaq. Li xyuwaʼchin laj David aʼan laj Obed. Li xnaʼ xyuwaʼ laj Obed aʼan li xRut ut laj Boaz. Li xyuwaʼ laj David aʼan laj Jese. Laj David naril xkarneer li xyuwaʼ. Ak 10 chihabʼ rokik chi awabʼejink laj Saul naq kiyoʼlaak laj David.

Kiwulak xkutankil naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Samuel: ‹Kʼam li aseeyt saʼ rochoch laj Jese. Xbʼaan naq xinsikʼ ru jun rehebʼ li ralal choʼq awabʼej›. Naq laj Samuel kiril ru laj Eliab, li xbʼeen ralal laj Jese, kixkʼoxla: ‹Aʼin tana sikʼbʼil ru xbʼaan li Jehobʼa›. Abʼan li Jehobʼa kixye re: ‹Maawil xchʼinaʼusal chi moko li xnajtil roq. Moko aʼan ta xinsikʼ ru›.

Tojaʼ naq laj Jese kixbʼoq laj Abinadab ut kixkʼe chiru laj Samuel. Laj Samuel kixye: ‹Moko aʼan ta sikʼbʼil ru xbʼaan li Jehobʼa›. Chirix chik aʼan laj Jese kixkʼam laj Samah, li ralal, chiru laj Samuel. Tojaʼ naq laj Samuel kixye: ‹Moko aʼan ta sikʼbʼil ru xbʼaan li Jehobʼa›. Laj Jese kixkʼamebʼ wuqubʼ li ralal chiru laj Samuel, abʼan maajun rehebʼ keʼsikʼeʼk ru. Joʼkan naq kixye laj Samuel: ‹Ma aʼin chixjunilebʼ laawalal?›

Laj Jese kixye re: ‹Wank jun chik li walal toj saaj, abʼan yook chaq rilbʼalebʼ li karneer›. Naq laj Samuel kiril laj David, kixkʼe reetal naq chʼinaʼus naʼilok. Tojaʼ naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Samuel: ‹Aʼin xinsikʼ ru. Kʼe li aseeyt saʼ xjolom›. Laj Samuel kixbʼaanu li kixye li Jehobʼa. Moqon chik, laj David kikanaak choʼq awabʼej saʼ li tenamit Israel.1 Samuel 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

EBʼ LAJ Filisteo keʼchalk wiʼ chik chi yalok saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel. Li oxibʼ chi ras laj David wankebʼ choʼq aj puubʼ rikʼin laj Saul. Joʼkan naq saʼ jun kutan laj Jese kixye re laj David: ‹Ilebʼ chaq chanru wankebʼ laawas. Ut kʼamebʼ xtzakahemq›.

Naq laj David kiwulak saʼ xyanqebʼ laj puubʼ kiʼok xsikʼbʼalebʼ li ras. Laj Goliat kiʼelk chaq chi xhobʼalebʼ laj Israel. Kixhobʼebʼ chiru 40 kutan. Tojaʼ naq kixye: ‹Sikʼomaq junaq winq re naq tyaloq wikʼin. Wi tinxkamsi, tookanaaq choʼq eemoos. Abʼan wi tinkamsi texkanaaq choʼq qamoos. Joʼkan naq sikʼomaq junaq saʼ eeyanq re naq tyaloq wikʼin›. Laj David kixye rehebʼ laj puubʼ: ‹Kʼaru tkʼeheʼq re li ani tkamsinq re laj Filisteo re naq inkʼaʼ tkanaaq saʼ xutaan li tenamit Israel?›

Jun laj puubʼ kixye re laj David: ‹Laj Saul tixbʼaanu naq li winq aʼin tbʼihomoʼq ut tixkʼe li xrabʼin choʼq rixaqil›.

Chixjunilebʼ laj Israel nekeʼxuwak chiru laj Goliat, xbʼaan naq oxibʼ meetr xnajtil roq. Jun laj puubʼ naxkʼam li xsursuukil chʼiichʼ laj Goliat.

Wiibʼ oxibʼ rehebʼ laj puubʼ keʼxye chaq re laj Saul naq laj David traj yalok rikʼin laj Goliat. Tojaʼ naq laj Saul kixye re laj David: ‹Inkʼaʼ tatruuq chi yalok rikʼin laj Goliat, Xbʼaan naq toj kachʼinat. Li winq aʼin aj puubʼ ut kʼaynaq chi yalok›. Laj David kixye re laj Saul: ‹Laaʼin xinkamsi jun li oso ut jun li kaqkoj, li xeʼkʼamok re xkarneer linyuwaʼ. Joʼkan ajwiʼ tixkʼul saʼ wuqʼ laj Filisteo. Li Jehobʼa ttenqʼanq we›. Joʼkan naq laj Saul kixye re laj David: ‹Ayu, li Jehobʼa taxaq ttenqʼanq aawe›.

Laj David kixxok oobʼ chi pek saʼ li nimaʼ ut kixkʼe saʼ xchampa. Chirix chik aʼan kixkʼam chirix li xrantʼin ut xko xtawbʼal chaq laj Goliat. Naq laj Goliat kiril ru laj David, kixkʼoxla naq moko chʼaʼaj ta chiru xkamsinkil.

Chirix chik aʼan laj Goliat kixye re laj David: ‹Jilonk chaq arin re naq tinkʼe laatibʼel rehebʼ li xul›. Abʼan laj David kixye re: ‹Laaʼat nakatchalk saʼ inbʼeen rikʼin laajutzʼ chʼiichʼ, abʼan laaʼin tinxik saʼ aabʼen saʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li Jehobʼa. Li Jehobʼa tatxkʼe saʼ wuqʼ re naq tatinkamsi›.

Laj David kiʼaanilak chi xtawbʼal laj Goliat. Tojaʼ naq kixkʼe jun li pek chiru li xrantʼin ut kixkut chi anchal xchʼool saʼ xbʼeen laj Goliat. Li pek kiʼok saʼ xjolom laj Goliat ut kikamk. Naq ebʼ laj Filisteo keʼril aʼin, keʼelelik. Tojaʼ naq ebʼ laj Israel xkohebʼ chirix ut keʼelk chiʼus saʼ li yalok.1 Samuel 17:1-54. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ David ak xkamsi laj Goliat naq laj Abner, laj jolominel rehebʼ laj puubʼ re Israel, kixkʼam laj David rikʼin laj Saul. Laj Saul kixkʼe ajwiʼ laj David choʼq aj jolominel saʼ xyanqebʼ laj puubʼ ut kixkʼul saʼ rochoch.

Naq ebʼ laj puubʼ keʼsutqʼiik chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Filisteo, ebʼ li ixq keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Naabʼal kixkamsihebʼ laj Saul, abʼan laj David kixqʼax ru xkʼihal kixkamsi›. Laj Saul kichalk xjosqʼil xbʼaan naq keʼxnima ru laj David chiru aʼan. Abʼan laj Jonatan, li ralal laj Saul, moko kixkaqali ta laj David. Laj Jonatan ut laj David nekeʼxra ribʼ, joʼkan naq keʼxye naq junelik teʼwanq saʼ amiiwil. Laj David naxnaw xchʼeebʼal li aarp ut laj Saul nawulak chiru rabʼinkil. Laj Saul naxkaqali laj David. Saʼ jun kutan naq laj David yook xchʼeebʼal li aarp, laj Saul kiwakli ut kixkut li xjutzʼ chʼiichʼ saʼ xbʼeen laj David. Tojaʼ naq kixye laj Saul: ‹Ok we xtʼojbʼal laj David chiru tzʼak›. Abʼan laj David kixkol ribʼ chiru. Laj Saul toj kixkut wiʼ chik li xjutzʼ chʼiichʼ saʼ xbʼeen laj David. Naq laj Saul kixbʼaanu aʼin, laj David kixkʼe reetal naq yalaq joqʼe naru tkamsiiq.

Ma jultik aawe naq laj Saul kixyeechiʼi li xrabʼin re li winq li tkamsinq re laj Goliat. Joʼkan naq laj Saul kixye re laj David naq tixkʼe li xrabʼin re, wi tixkamsi 100 ebʼ aj Filisteo. Laj Saul kiraj naq ebʼ laj Filisteo teʼxkamsi laj David, abʼan moko kikʼulmank ta chi joʼkan. Laj Saul, kixkʼe li xrabʼin choʼq rixaqil laj David.

Saʼ jun kutan laj Saul kixye re laj Jonatan ut kixye rehebʼ li xmoos naq traj xkamsinkil laj David. Abʼan laj Jonatan kixye re laj Saul: ‹Maachʼeʼ laj David. Maakʼaʼ xmaak chaawu. Xatxtenqʼa naq kixkamsi laj Goliat ut naq kisutqʼiik chaq chi yalok kisahoʼk saʼ aachʼool naq xaawil ru›.

Laj Saul kixye re li ralal naq inkʼaʼ tixchʼeʼ laj David. Joʼkan naq laj David kiʼok chi kʼanjelak rikʼin laj Saul. Ut naq laj David yook xchʼeebʼal li aarp, laj Saul kixkut wiʼ chik li xjutzʼ chʼiichʼ saʼ xbʼeen. Abʼan laj David kixkol ribʼ, joʼkan naq li chʼiichʼ kiʼok chiru li tzʼak. Aʼin li rox sut naq kikamsiik raj laj David. Laj David kixye saʼ xchʼool naq t-eleliq.

Saʼ li qʼoqyink aʼan, laj David xko saʼ rochoch, abʼan ak xtaqlaak xkamsinkil xbʼaan laj Saul. Naq li xMical kixnaw li tixbʼaanu li xyuwaʼ, kixye re laj David: ‹Wi inkʼaʼ nakatxik saʼ li qʼoqyink aʼin, tateʼxkamsi›. Joʼkan naq li xMical kixtenqʼa laj David chi elk saʼ bʼentaan. Kachʼin chik ma wuqubʼ chihabʼ kixmuq ribʼ laj David chiru laj Saul. Ut kiwank saʼ jalan jalanq chi naʼaj.1 Samuel 17:55-58; 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

ANI li ixqaʼal yook chaq chi chalk chiru laj David? Aʼan li xʼAbigail. Li xʼAbigail wank xnaʼlebʼ, joʼkan naq inkʼaʼ kixkanabʼ naq laj David tmaakobʼq. Xbʼeenwa qilaq kʼaru yook xkʼulbʼal laj David.

Laj David kixmuq ribʼ saʼ jun ochoch pek naq kiʼelelik chiru laj Saul. Ebʼ li xkomon laj David keʼwulak rikʼin. Naq keʼxchʼutubʼ ribʼ 400 tana chi winq, laj David kikanaak chi jolomink saʼ xbʼeenebʼ. Tojaʼ naq laj David kiwulak rikʼin li awabʼej re Moab ut kixye re: ‹Xinchalk xpatzʼbʼal usilal chaawu re naq tkanaaq linnaʼ linyuwaʼ aawikʼin toj naq tinsutqʼiiq chaq›. Chirix chik aʼan, laj David ut ebʼ li winq keʼxmuq ribʼ saʼ pim.

Moqon chik laj David kixnaw ru li xʼAbigail. Aj Nabal xkʼabʼaʼ li xbʼeelom li xʼAbigail. Laj Nabal wank naabʼal xchʼochʼ, wank 3.000 xkarneer ut 1.000 xchibʼaat. Laj Nabal maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ. Abʼan li xʼAbigail chʼinaʼus naʼilok ut wank xnaʼlebʼ. Saʼ jun kutan li xʼAbigail kixkol li xjunkabʼal. Qilaq chanru kixbʼaanu aʼin.

Laj David ut ebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru chaabʼilebʼ rikʼin laj Nabal. Joʼkan naq keʼxtenqʼa chi xkʼaakʼalenkil ebʼ li xkarneer. Saʼ jun kutan laj David kixtaqlahebʼ li winq chi xpatzʼbʼal jun li usilal chiru laj Nabal. Laj Nabal ut li ebʼ li xmoos yookebʼ chi bʼesok rix karneer. Saʼ rochoch laj Nabal yook li ninqʼe ut wank naabʼal li chaabʼil xtzakahemq. Naq ebʼ li winq keʼwulak rikʼin laj Nabal keʼxye re: ‹Xoochalk xtzʼaamankil jun usilal chaawu, xbʼaan naq chaabʼilo aawikʼin. Xatqatenqʼa chi rilbʼalebʼ laakarneer ut maajunwa xqakʼam junaq rehebʼ laakarneer. Joʼkan naq, bʼaanu usilal kʼe qatzakahemq!›

Laj Nabal kiʼok xyeebʼal li yiibʼru aj aatin chirix laj David. Tojaʼ naq kixye rehebʼ li winq: ‹Inkʼaʼ tinkʼe eetzakahemq›. Naq laj David kirabʼi aʼin, kichalk xjosqʼil, joʼkan naq kixye rehebʼ li winq: ‹Chapomaq chaq leechʼiichʼ›. Laj David ut ebʼ li winq kohebʼ chi xkamsinkil laj Nabal ut ebʼ li xmoos.

Jun rehebʼ li xmoos laj Nabal kixye chaq re li xʼAbigail li kixbʼaanu laj Nabal. Joʼkan naq li xʼAbigail kixyiibʼ saʼ junpaat li tzakahemq ut kixkʼam saʼ xbʼeenebʼ li bʼuur. Naq li xʼAbigail kixtaw saʼ bʼe laj David kikubʼeek, kixwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiru ut kixye re: ‹Bʼaanu usilal! Maakʼe saʼ aachʼool li kixbʼaanu aawe linbʼeelom. Maakʼaʼ xnaʼlebʼ, joʼkan naq inkʼaʼ naxkʼoxla chiʼus kʼaru naxbʼaanu. Xinkʼam chaq li tzakahemq, kʼul bʼaanu usilal! Ut chaakuy qamaak›.

Laj David kixye re li xʼAbigail: ‹Wank aanaʼlebʼ, xaabʼaanu naq inkʼaʼ tinkamsi laj Nabal xbʼaan naq kimaakobʼk chiwu. Anaqwan tuqubʼ aachʼool ut ayu saʼ laawochoch›. Naq kikamk laj Nabal li xʼAbigail kiwank ajwiʼ choʼq rixaqil laj David.1 Samuel 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Saul toj traj xkamsinkil laj David, joʼkan naq kixkʼam 3.000 aj puubʼ chi xsikʼbʼal. Naq laj David kixnaw aʼin, kixtaqlahebʼ li winq chi rilbʼal bʼar yook chi hilank laj Saul. Tojaʼ naq laj David kixye rehebʼ wiibʼ li winq: ‹Ani eere txik chiwix bʼarwiʼ yook chi hilank laj Saul?›

Laj Abisai, xyum xZeruya; ranabʼ laj David, kixye: ‹Laaʼin tinxik chaawix›. Laj David ut laj Abisai keʼok bʼarwiʼ yookebʼ chi wark laj Saul ut ebʼ laj puubʼ. Maaʼani kiʼilok rehebʼ chi moko keʼrabʼi ta naq keʼok. Tojaʼ naq laj David kixchap chi xkʼatq xjolom laj Saul, li xjutzʼ chʼiichʼ ut xnaʼaj li xhaʼ laj Saul.

Naq laj David ut laj Abisai keʼelk chaq chi xkʼatq laj Saul kohebʼ saʼ xbʼeen jun li tzuul. Tojaʼ naq laj David kixye re li nakʼaakʼalenk re laj Saul: ‹Abner, kʼaʼut naq inkʼaʼ yookat xkʼaakʼalenkil laj eechal aawe? Ma nakaanaw bʼar wank li xjutzʼ chʼiichʼ ut xnaʼaj li xhaʼ laj Saul?›

Naq kiʼajk ru laj Saul, kirabʼi xyaabʼ xkux laj David. Laj Saul kixye: ‹David, ma laaʼat yookat chi aatinak?› Laj Saul ut laj Abner wankebʼ taqʼa ut yookebʼ rabʼinkil laj David.

Laj David kixye re laj Saul: ‹Laaʼin at awabʼej, kʼaʼut naq taawaj inkamsinkil? Kʼaru xinbʼaanu aawe? Arin wank laajutzʼ chʼiichʼ, chalqebʼ xkʼambʼal›. Laj Saul kixye re laj David: ‹Maaʼus innaʼlebʼ, moko us ta xinbʼaanu›. Chirix chik aʼan, xko laj David ut laj Saul kisutqʼiik saʼ rochoch. Tojaʼ naq laj David kiʼok xkʼoxlankil: ‹Twulaq xqʼehil naq laj Saul tinxkamsi. Tinxik saʼ xtenamitebʼ laj Filisteo›. Naq laj David kiwulak saʼ xyanqebʼ laj Filisteo kixbʼalaqʼihebʼ, xbʼaan naq kixbʼaanu ribʼ naq tixtenqʼahebʼ.

Chirix chik aʼan ebʼ laj Filisteo xkohebʼ chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Israel. Saʼ li yalok aʼin, laj Saul ut laj Jonatan keʼkamk ut laj David kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool. Joʼkan naq kixtzʼiibʼa jun li bʼich ut kixye: ‹At Jonatan, ra inchʼool aabʼan. Kʼajoʼ naq xatinra!›

Tojaʼ naq laj David kisutqʼiik Israel saʼ li tenamit Hebron. Saʼ li tenamit Hebron wiibʼ chʼuut chi winq yookebʼ chi yalok, xbʼaan naq keʼxsikʼ ru ani t-awabʼejinq rehebʼ. Jun chʼuut kixsikʼ choʼq awabʼej laj Is-boset, ralal laj Saul. Ut li jun chik chʼuut kixsikʼ choʼq awabʼej laj David. Abʼan ebʼ li keʼsikʼok re laj David keʼelk chiʼus saʼ li yalok. Laj David kiʼok chi awabʼejink naq wank 30 chihabʼ re ut chiru 7 chihabʼ rikʼin 6 po kiʼawabʼejink saʼ li tenamit Hebron. Aran kiyoʼlaak laj Amnon, laj Absalon ut laj Adonias, ebʼ li ralal laj David.

Moqon chik, laj David ut ebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru, kohebʼ reechaninkil li tenamit Jerusalen. Ut laj Joab jun chik rehebʼ li xyum xZeruya kikʼamok bʼe saʼ li yalok aʼin. Joʼkan naq laj David kixxaqabʼ laj Joab choʼq aj jolominel saʼ xyanqebʼ laj puubʼ ut laj David kiʼok chi awabʼejink saʼ li tenamit Jerusalen.1 Samuel 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuel 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Crónicas 11:1-9. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ David ak yook chi awabʼejink saʼ li tenamit Jerusalen naq li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq naabʼal sut teʼelq chiʼus saʼ li yalok. Li Jehobʼa kixyeechiʼi li tenamit Canaan rehebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq, saʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li Jehobʼa keʼreechani chixjunil li chʼochʼ aʼin.

Laj David naxra li Jehobʼa ut naxnaw awabʼejink. Naq keʼreechani li tenamit Jerusalen laj David kixkʼam aran xkaaxil li sumwank. Joʼkan naq traj xyiibʼankil jun Rochoch li Jehobʼa re naq wanq xnaʼaj li kaax aʼin.

Keʼnumeʼk li chihabʼ ut laj David kimaakobʼk. Laj David naxnaw naq nimla maak xchapbʼal li maawaʼ qe. Saʼ jun qʼoqyink, laj David yook chi bʼeek saʼ xmuhebʼaal li rochoch naq kiʼilok taqʼa kixkʼe reetal naq wank jun li ixq chʼinaʼus naʼilok. Aʼan li xBat-seba ut aj Urias xkʼabʼaʼ li xbʼeelom li ixq aʼin. Laj Urias nakʼanjelak choʼq aj puubʼ rikʼin laj David.

Laj David kixra ru wank rikʼin xBat-seba joʼkan naq kixtaqla xbʼoqbʼal. Li xbʼeelom li xBat-seba najt yook chaq chi yalok. Laj David kiwank rikʼin li ixq. Chirix chik aʼan, kixnaw naq li xBat-seba wank saʼ yuʼam. Laj David kiʼok xkʼaʼuxl, joʼkan naq kixye re laj Joab, li najolomink rehebʼ laj puubʼ, naq tixkʼe laj Urias chiruhebʼ li xikʼ nekeʼilok rehebʼ re naq tkamsiiq. Naq kikamk laj Urias, laj David kisumlaak rikʼin xBat-seba.

Li Jehobʼa kichalk xjosqʼil rikʼin laj David. Joʼkan naq kixtaqla laj Natan re xyeebʼal re laj David li xmaak. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq laj Natan wank rikʼin laj David. Laj David kiyotʼeʼk xchʼool, joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kixkamsi. Laj Natan kixye re laj David: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xatmaakobʼk, anaqwan tchalq li rahilal saʼ laajunkabʼal›. Nim li rahilal kichalk saʼ xbʼeen laj David!

Joʼkan naq, kikamk li xyum li xBat-seba. Chirix chik aʼan, laj Amnon, li xbʼeen ralal laj David, kixchap ut kiyoklaak rikʼin li xTamar, li ranabʼ. Tojaʼ naq, kichalk xjosqʼil laj Absalon ut kixkamsi laj Amnon, li ras. Laj Absalon kixbʼaanu naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼxkʼe choʼq awabʼej. Laj David kiʼelk chiʼus naq kiyalok rikʼin laj Absalon. Tojaʼ naq kikamk laj Absalon. Naabʼal li rahilal kixkʼul laj David.

Li xBat-seba kiwank jun chik xyum, aj Salomon kixkʼe choʼq xkʼabʼaʼ. Ak cheek ut yaj laj David naq laj Adonias, li ralal, kixyal kanaak choʼq awabʼej. Joʼkan naq laj David kixye re laj Sadoc, laj tij, naq tixkʼe aseeyt saʼ xjolom laj Salomon re xkʼutbʼesinkil naq li ralal aʼin tkanaaq choʼq awabʼej. Moqon chik kikamk laj David naq wank 70 chihabʼ re. Chiru 40 chihabʼ kiʼawabʼejink laj David ut laj Salomon kikanaak choʼq awabʼej.2 Samuel 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Reyes 1:1-48. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

TOJ saaj chiʼus laj Salomon naq kiʼok chi awabʼejink. Naxra li Jehobʼa ut junelik kixbʼaanu li kiyeheʼk re xbʼaan laj David, li xyuwaʼ. Li Jehobʼa naxra laj Salomon. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Salomon naq yook chi wark: ‹Kʼaru taawaj naq tinkʼe aawe?›

Laj Salomon kixye: ‹At Jehobʼa kʼe innaʼlebʼ, re naq tin-awabʼejinq chiʼus. Toj saajin ut inkʼaʼ ninnaw xjolominkil laatenamit›.

Li Jehobʼa kiwulak chiru li kixpatzʼ laj Salomon, joʼkan naq kixye re: ‹Xaapatzʼ aanaʼlebʼ, abʼan inkʼaʼ xaapatzʼ xnajtil ru laayuʼam, chi moko aabʼihomal. Joʼkan naq tinkʼe naabʼal aanaʼlebʼ chiru yalaq ani. Joʼkan ajwiʼ tinkʼe aabʼihomal ut aaloqʼal usta inkʼaʼ xaatzʼaama chiwu›.

Moqon chik, wiibʼ li ixq keʼchalk rikʼin laj Salomon xbʼaan naq wankebʼ saʼ chʼaʼajkilal. Jun rehebʼ li ixq kixye re laj Salomon: ‹Li ixq aʼin ut laaʼin wanko saʼ jun chi ochoch. Laaʼin kiwank jun linchʼina yum ut wiibʼ kutan xyoʼlajik linyum naq kiyoʼlaak ajwiʼ jun xyum li ixq aʼin. Abʼan saʼ jun qʼoqyink li xchʼina yum li ixq aʼin, kikamk. Yookin chi wark naq kixkʼe li xkʼuulaʼal chinkʼatq ut kixkʼam linkʼuulaʼal chixkʼatq. Naq kiʼajk wu xinkʼe reetal naq li kʼuulaʼal kamenaq ut maawaʼ li we›.

Naq li jun chik ixq kirabʼi aʼin kixye: ‹Inkʼaʼ! We li yoʼyo ut re li kamenaq!› Tojaʼ naq li xbʼeen ixq kixye wiʼ chik: ‹Inkʼaʼ! Laawe aʼan li kamenaq ut li we aʼan li yoʼyo!› Ebʼ li ixq inkʼaʼ nekeʼxkʼe ribʼ saʼ aatin. Kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Salomon rikʼin li chʼaʼajkilal aʼin?

Laj Salomon kixpatzʼ jun li chʼiichʼ ut naq ak wank rikʼin kixye: ‹Yokʼomaq saʼ wiibʼ jachal li kʼuulaʼal li yoʼyo ut qʼaxtesihomaq jun jachal re li junjunq chi ixq›. Naq li xnaʼ li kʼuulaʼal kirabʼi aʼin kixjap re xyeebʼal: ‹Inkʼaʼ! Meekamsi li kʼuulaʼal, bʼaanumaq usilal! Kʼemaq li kʼuulaʼal re li ixq aʼin!› Abʼan li jun chik ixq kixye: ‹Inkʼaʼ! Chi moko re, chi moko we ta teekʼe, jachamaq saʼ xyi li kʼuulaʼal›.

Tojaʼ naq laj Salomon kixye: ‹Meekamsi li kʼuulaʼal! Kʼemaq li kʼuulaʼal re li xbʼeen ixq xbʼaan naq aʼan li xnaʼ li chʼinaʼal›. Laj Salomon naxnaw naq li xbʼeen ixq aʼan li naʼbʼej, xbʼaan naq naxra li kʼuulaʼal ut inkʼaʼ kiraj naq tkamsiiq. Naq li tenamit kirabʼi aʼin, keʼsahoʼk saʼ xchʼool xbʼaan naq laj Salomon wank xnaʼlebʼ.

Chiru chixjunil li chihabʼ naq kiʼawabʼejink laj Salomon, li Yos kirosobʼtesi li tenamit; kixbʼaanu naq tmoq naabʼal li triiw, li sebʼaad, li uubʼ, li iig ut naabʼal chik li tzakahemq. Chaabʼil xtiqibʼankilebʼ li qas qiitzʼin ut chaabʼil ajwiʼ ebʼ li rochoch. Joʼkan naq sahebʼ saʼ xchʼool.1 Reyes 3:3-28; 4:25-34. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Salomon ut li Rochoch li Yos
data.contenido:
AK KAMK re laj David naq kixye re laj Salomon chanru teʼxyiibʼ li Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Kaahibʼ chihabʼ rokik chi awabʼejink laj Salomon naq kiʼok xyiibʼankil li Rochoch li Yos ut kixchoy chiru 7 chihabʼ ut 6 po. Numenaq 180.000 ebʼ li winq keʼkʼanjelak ut naabʼal li oor ut li plaat keʼroksi naq keʼxyiibʼ li ochoch.

Saʼ li ochoch aʼin wank wiibʼ li naʼaj, joʼ li naʼaj li kixyiibʼ chaq laj Moises naq kixyiibʼ li Rochoch li Yos. Abʼan ebʼ li naʼaj aʼin, jwal nim chiru li kixyiibʼ laj Moises. Laj Salomon kixbʼaanu naq teʼxkʼe chaq xkaaxil li sumwank saʼ jun rehebʼ li naʼaj aʼin.

Naq keʼraqeʼk xyiibʼankil li ochoch keʼxnima ru. Laj Salomon kixwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiru li Rochoch li Yos ut kitijok. Tojaʼ naq kixye re li Jehobʼa: ‹Li choxa qʼaxal nim ut inkʼaʼ tzʼaqal choʼq aanaʼaj, ma tojaʼ ta chik li ochoch li xinyiibʼ choʼq aawe! Bʼaanu usilal, chaawabʼi li tenamit naq ttijoq chaawu saʼ li naʼaj aʼin!›

Naq laj Salomon kiraqeʼk chi tijok kikubʼeek chaq li xaml saʼ choxa ut kixkʼat li mayej xul. Ut li xloqʼal li Jehobʼa kikutanobʼresink re li ochoch. Chi joʼkan kikʼutunk naq li Jehobʼa kirabʼi li xtij laj Salomon ut sa saʼ xchʼool rikʼin li ochoch aʼin. Anaqwan ebʼ laj Israel keʼok xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa saʼ li ochoch li kixyiibʼ laj Salomon ut maawaʼ chik saʼ li ochoch li kixyiibʼ chaq laj Moises. Chiru naabʼal chihabʼ laj Salomon kiwank xnaʼlebʼ naq yook chi awabʼejink ut li tenamit sa saʼ xchʼool rikʼin. Laj Salomon kisumlaak rikʼin naabʼal chi ixq. Ebʼ li ixq aʼin inkʼaʼ nekeʼxloqʼoni li Jehobʼa. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq jun rehebʼ li ixq yook xloqʼoninkil li pechʼbʼil yos. Ebʼ li ixq aʼin keʼxbʼaanu naq laj Salomon tixloqʼonihebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kikʼulmank naq laj Salomon kiʼok xloqʼoninkil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos? Laj Salomon kiʼok chi rahobʼtesink, joʼkan naq li tenamit moko sa ta chik saʼ xchʼool.

Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kichalk xjosqʼil rikʼin laj Salomon ut kixye re: ‹Twisi laawankil ut tinkʼe re jalan chik. Aʼin inkʼaʼ tinbʼaanu naq yoʼyooqat, tinbʼaanu naq ak yooq chi awabʼejink laawalal. Abʼan inkʼaʼ tinmaqʼ chiru chixjunil li tenamit›. Qatzolaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.1 Crónicas 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Reyes 5:1-18; 2 Crónicas 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Reyes 11:9-13. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW kʼaʼut naq li winq aʼin yook xpejbʼal li raqʼ? Li Jehobʼa kitaqlank re li winq chi xbʼaanunkil aʼin. Li winq aʼin aj Ahiya ut nakʼanjelak chiru li Yos. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru xkʼanjel laj Ahiya chiru li Jehobʼa? Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Ahiya kʼaru tkʼulmanq saʼ li kutan chaalel.

Laj Ahiya yook chi aatinak rikʼin laj Jeroboan. Laj Jeroboan kikʼeheʼk xwankil naq kikʼanjelak rikʼin laj Salomon. Naq laj Ahiya kixtaw laj Jeroboan saʼ bʼe kirisi li raqʼ chirix ut kixpeji saʼ 12 jachal. Tojaʼ naq laj Ahiya kixye: ‹Kʼam 10 jachal ru li tʼikr›. Kʼaʼut naq kixsi re laj Jeroboan 10 jachal ru li tʼikr aʼin?

Laj Ahiya kixye re laj Jeroboan naq li Jehobʼa tixmaqʼ li awabʼejilal chiru laj Salomon ut tixkʼe re aʼan 10 chi teep re naq tixjolomi. Joʼkan naq kaʼajwiʼ wiibʼ chi teep tixjolomi laj Rehoboam, ralal laj Salomon.

Kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil laj Salomon naq kirabʼi li kixye laj Ahiya re laj Jeroboan. Joʼkan naq kiraj xkamsinkil laj Jeroboan, abʼan laj Jeroboan xko Egipto. Laj Salomon kiʼawabʼejink chiru 40 chihabʼ. Naq kikamk laj Salomon, li ralal kikanaak choʼq awabʼej ut laj Jeroboan kiʼelk chaq Egipto ut kisutqʼiik saʼ li tenamit Israel.

Laj Rehoboam moko us ta kiʼawabʼejink, xbʼaan naq maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ rikʼin li tenamit. Kixqʼax ru xmaaʼusilal chiru li kixbʼaanu laj Salomon. Joʼkan naq laj Jeroboan ut ebʼ li winq li wankebʼ xwankil saʼ Israel, kohebʼ xyeebʼal re naq tixjal xnaʼlebʼ rikʼin li tenamit. Laj Rehoboam inkʼaʼ kirabʼihebʼ ut kinumtaak li xmaaʼusilal. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxkʼe laj Jeroboan chi xjolominkil li 10 chi teep. Abʼan laj Rehoboam kikanaak rikʼin xteep laj Benjamin ut laj Juda.

Laj Jeroboan inkʼaʼ kiraj naq ebʼ 10 chi teep teʼxik Jerusalen chi xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq kixyiibʼ wiibʼ li pechʼbʼil yos re oor, re naq aʼan chik teʼxloqʼoni ru. Chirix chik aʼan kinumtaak li maaʼusilal ut li rahilal saʼ li tenamit.

Wank ajwiʼ chʼaʼajkilal saʼ li xteep laj Benjamin ut saʼ li xteep laj Juda. Toj maajiʼ naxbʼaanu oobʼ chihabʼ laj Rehoboam saʼ li xʼawabʼejilal, naq li awabʼej re Egipto kichalk chi yalok saʼ xbʼeen li tenamit Jerusalen. Li awabʼej re Egipto kirelqʼa naabʼal li kʼaʼaq re ru saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq li Rochoch li Jehobʼa moko najt ta kiwank joʼ naq keʼxyiibʼ chaq saʼ xtiklajik.1 Reyes 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

NAQ kikamk li awabʼej Jeroboan, chixjunilebʼ li awabʼej li keʼjolomink rehebʼ li 10 chi teep maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Abʼan li awabʼej Acab, jwal yiibʼru xnaʼlebʼ. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut? Xbʼaan naq li xJezabel, li rixaqil, wank choʼq awabʼej ut maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ.

Li xJezabel moko aj Israel ta, aʼan xrabʼin li awabʼej re li tenamit Sidon. Li xJezabel naxloqʼoni li pechʼbʼil yos Bʼaal, kixbʼaanu naq li xbʼeelom ut naabʼalebʼ laj Israel teʼxloqʼoni ajwiʼ li yos aʼin. Li xJezabel xikʼ naril li Jehobʼa ut kixkamsi naabʼalebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa. Wankebʼ keʼxmuq ribʼ saʼebʼ li ochoch pek re naq inkʼaʼ teʼkamsiiq. Li xJezabel nakamsink, re xtawbʼal li naraj.

Saʼ jun kutan li xJezabel kiril naq laj Acab ra saʼ xchʼool. Tojaʼ naq kixpatzʼ re: ‹Kʼaʼut ra saʼ aachʼool?›

Laj Acab kixye re li rixaqil: ‹Xwaj raj xloqʼbʼal li xchʼochʼ laj Nabot, abʼan inkʼaʼ kiru xkʼeebʼal we›.

Li xJezabel kixye re li xbʼeelom: ‹Matkʼoxlak, laaʼin tinkʼe aawe li xchʼochʼ laj Nabot›.

Li xJezabel kixtaqlahebʼ xhu ebʼ li nekeʼjolomink saʼ li tenamit bʼarwiʼ wank laj Nabot. Ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Taqlahomaq winq li maakʼaʼ nekeʼok wiʼ re naq teʼxye re li tenamit naq laj Nabot kixmaajewa li Yos ut li awabʼej. Chirix chik aʼan: Teerisi laj Nabot saʼ li tenamit ut teekʼe chi pek toj reetal teekamsi›.

Naq li xJezabel kirabʼi naq kikamk laj Nabot kixye re laj Acab: ‹Anaqwan aawe chik li xchʼochʼ laj Nabot›. Tento raj naq li xJezabel tixtoj li xmaak, xbʼaan naq kʼajoʼ xyiibʼal ru kixbʼaanu!

Joʼkan naq, li Jehobʼa kixtaqla laj Jehu re naq tixtoj xmaak li xJezabel. Naq li xJezabel kirabʼi naq yook chaq chi chalk laj Jehu, kixbʼon chiʼus li xnaqʼru re naq t-ileʼq naq chʼinaʼus naʼilok. Abʼan, naq laj Jehu kiril ru li xJezabel kixye rehebʼ li nekeʼkʼanjelak saʼ li rochoch li awabʼej: ‹Kutumaq li ixq saʼ li bʼentaan›. Ebʼ li winq keʼxbʼaanu li yeebʼilebʼ re, joʼ nakʼutunk saʼ li eetalil. Chi joʼkan kikamk li xJezabel.1 Reyes 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Reyes 9:30-37. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

ANIHEBʼ li winq li wankebʼ saʼ li eetalil ut kʼaru yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil? Ebʼ li winq aʼin yookebʼ chi bʼichank ut xikebʼ re chi yalok. Qilaq, kʼaʼut naq maakʼaʼebʼ xchʼiichʼ ut xjutzʼ cheʼ?

Laj Jehosafat aʼan li awabʼej re li xteep laj Benjamin ut laj Juda. Laj Jehosafat kiwank saʼ xkutankil naq laj Acab ut li xJezabel yookebʼ xjolominkil li 10 chi teep re Israel. Laj Jehosafat chaabʼil awabʼej. Joʼkan ajwiʼ laj Asa, li xyuwaʼ laj Jehosafat, chaabʼil naq kiwank chaq. Joʼkan naq chiru naabʼal chihabʼ ebʼ li wiibʼ chi teep sahebʼ chaq saʼ xchʼool.

Ebʼ laj Israel yookebʼ xxiw. Xbʼaan naq wiibʼ oxibʼ chi winq keʼxye re laj Jehosafat: ‹Naabʼalebʼ laj Moab, laj Amon ut ebʼ laj Seir teʼchalq chi yalok saʼ aabʼeen›. Joʼkan naq naabʼalebʼ laj Israel keʼxchʼutubʼ ribʼ saʼ li tenamit Jerusalen saʼ Rochoch li Yos re naq li Jehobʼa ttenqʼanq rehebʼ. Aran kitijok laj Jehosafat: ‹Jehobʼa, at inYos, inkʼaʼ naqanaw kʼaru tqabʼaanu. Naabʼalebʼ laj puubʼ chalkebʼ re saʼ qabʼeen. Chooʼaatenqʼa, bʼaanu usilal!›

Li Jehobʼa kirabʼi li xtij laj Jehosafat, joʼkan naq kixtaqla jun rehebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru re naq tixye re li tenamit: ‹Li yalok aʼin re li Yos ut maawaʼ eere. Moko laaʼex ta texyaloq. Teeril chanru texkol li Jehobʼa›.

Naq kisaqewk, laj Jehosafat kixye re li tenamit: ‹Kʼojobʼamaq eechʼool rikʼin li Jehobʼa›. Tojaʼ naq kixkʼehebʼ laj bʼich chiruhebʼ laj puubʼ. Naq yookebʼ chi xik saʼ li yalok, yookebʼ ajwiʼ chi bʼichank chiru li Jehobʼa. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kikʼulmank naq ebʼ laj Israel wulakebʼ re saʼ li naʼaj bʼarwiʼ teʼyaloq? Li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq ebʼ laj puubʼ, li xikʼ nekeʼilok rehebʼ, teʼyaloq chiribʼilebʼ ribʼ. Naq keʼwulak, keʼxtaw ebʼ laj puubʼ chi kamenaq.

Laj Jehosafat wank xnaʼlebʼ, joʼkan naq kixkʼojobʼ xchʼool rikʼin li Yos. Wi tqakʼojobʼ qachʼool rikʼin li Jehobʼa tqakʼutbʼesi ajwiʼ naq wank qanaʼlebʼ.1 Reyes 22:41-53; 2 Crónicas 20:1-30. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

WI TKAMQ raj junaq chʼinaʼal, kʼaru tixye li xnaʼ wi twakliiq raj wiʼ chik chi yoʼyo? Kʼajoʼ raj tsahoʼq saʼ xchʼool chi rilbʼal! Abʼan, ma aawabʼihom naq xwakliik wiʼ chik chi yoʼyo junaq kamenaq?

Saʼ li eetalil wank jun li winq, wank jun li ixq ut jun li chʼinaʼal. Li winq aʼan laj Elias ut aj kʼanjel chiru li Yos. Li ixq aʼin kiyoʼlaak saʼ li tenamit Sarepta ut malkaʼan. Ut li chʼinaʼal aʼan li xyum li malkaʼan. Abʼan saʼ jun kutan li chʼinaʼal kinimank xyajel ut kikamk. Naq kikamk li chʼinaʼal laj Elias kixye re li malkaʼan: ‹Kʼe we laayum›.

Laj Elias kixkʼam li chʼinaʼal saʼ xkabʼ tasal li ochoch ut kixkʼe saʼ chʼaat. Ut kixye re li Jehobʼa: ‹At Jehobʼa bʼaanu usilal waklesi wiʼ chik chi yoʼyo li chʼinaʼal aʼin›. Tojaʼ naq kikʼulunk xchʼool li chʼinaʼal! Chirix chik aʼan laj Elias kikubʼeek chaq rikʼin li chʼinaʼal ut kixye re li malkaʼan: ‹Laayum yoʼyo›. Li malkaʼan kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool naq kiril ru li xyum.

Laj Eliseo aʼan jun chik laj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa. Laj Eliseo natenqʼank re laj Elias. Li Jehobʼa kixkʼe xwankil laj Eliseo re naq tixbʼaanu ajwiʼ li sachbʼachʼoolej. Naq laj Eliseo kiwulak saʼ li tenamit Sunem kixtaw jun li qanaʼchin jwal chaabʼil rikʼin. Chirix chik aʼan li qanaʼchin aʼin ut li xbʼeelom keʼwank jun li xyum.

Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixkʼul li chʼinaʼal naq ak nim chik? Saʼ jun eqʼla li chʼinaʼal xko xtawbʼal li xyuwaʼ saʼ li xkʼanjel. Tojaʼ naq kiʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Kʼajoʼ xrahil linjolom!› Naq li chʼinaʼal kiwulak saʼ rochoch, kikamk. Kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool li xnaʼ, joʼkan naq xko saʼ junpaat chi xsikʼbʼal laj Eliseo.

Laj Eliseo kiwulak saʼ rochoch li qanaʼchin ut kixkʼam li chʼinaʼal saʼ xchʼaat, kitijok ut kiyoklaak saʼ xbʼeen. Tojaʼ naq kiʼok chi luhaak xtibʼel li chʼinaʼal ut wuqubʼ sut kiʼatʼisamak. Naq li naʼbʼej kiril naq li xyum kiʼajk ru, kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool!

Naq nekeʼkamk li qakomon ut ebʼ li qamiiw narahoʼk saʼ qachʼool. Abʼan laaʼo inkʼaʼ nokooru xwaklesinkilebʼ chi yoʼyo. Kaʼajwiʼ li Jehobʼa naru xwaklesinkilebʼ li kamenaq. Toj tqatzol chanru tixbʼaanu aʼin.1 Reyes 17:8-24; 2 Reyes 4:8-37. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Jun li Chʼina Ixqaʼal aj Israel
data.contenido:
MA NAKAANAW kʼaru yook xyeebʼal li chʼina ixqaʼal re li rixaqil jun li awabʼej? Yook chi aatinak chirix laj Eliseo, laj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa. Yook ajwiʼ xyeebʼal naq li Jehobʼa natenqʼank re laj Eliseo. Li qanaʼchin inkʼaʼ naxnaw ani li Jehobʼa, xbʼaan naq moko aj Israel ta. Abʼan, kʼaʼut naq li chʼina ixqaʼal wank saʼ rochoch li qanaʼchin?

Li qanaʼchin kiyoʼlaak saʼ li tenamit Siria ut aj Naaman xkʼabʼaʼ li xbʼeelom. Laj Naaman najolomink rehebʼ laj puubʼ saʼ li tenamit Siria. Ebʼ laj Siria keʼxkʼam li chʼina ixqaʼal saʼ xtenamitebʼ, joʼkan naq kikanaak choʼq xmoos li rixaqil laj Naaman.

Laj Naaman wank saqlep chirix. Li ani wank xsaqlep naru natʼoyeʼk xtibʼel. Joʼkan naq li chʼina ixqaʼal yook xyeebʼal: ‹Wi laabʼeelom txik raj chi rilbʼal laj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa, li winq aʼin naru t-isinq re xyajel›. Chirix chik aʼan keʼxye re laj Naaman li kixye li chʼina ixqaʼal.

Laj Naaman naraj kʼiraak, joʼkan naq xko chi rilbʼal laj Eliseo saʼ li tenamit Israel. Naq laj Naaman kiwulak, laj Eliseo kixye re li xmoos naq tixye re laj Naaman naq tixchʼaj ribʼ wuqubʼ sut saʼ li nimaʼ Jordan. Naq laj Naaman kirabʼi aʼin kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil ut kixye: ‹Jwal chaabʼilebʼ li nimaʼ saʼ lintenamit chiruhebʼ li wank arin Israel›. Naq kiraqeʼk xyeebʼal aʼin, kisutqʼiik.

Tojaʼ naq ebʼ li xmoos laj Naaman keʼxye re: ‹Wi laj Eliseo tatxtaqla xbʼaanunkil junaq li naʼlebʼ, taabʼaanu raj usta chʼaʼaj xbʼaanunkil. Kʼaʼut naq inkʼaʼ nakaawaj xsubʼal aawibʼ saʼ haʼ joʼ kixye aawe?› Chirix chik aʼan, laj Naaman kixsubʼ ribʼ wuqubʼ sut saʼ li nimaʼ. Tojaʼ naq kiʼok chi kʼiraak.

Sa saʼ xchʼool laj Naaman, joʼkan naq kisutqʼiik rikʼin laj Eliseo ut kixye chaq re: ‹Anaqwan chʼolchʼo chiwu naq li xYos ebʼ laj Israel, aʼan xYosil chixjunil li Ruuchichʼochʼ. Joʼkan naq xinchalk xkanabʼankil aawe li maatan aʼin›. Laj Eliseo kixye re laj Naaman: ‹Inkʼaʼ tinkʼul li maatan›. Laj Eliseo inkʼaʼ kixkʼul li maatan xbʼaan naq li Jehobʼa kikʼirtasink re laj Naaman ut maawaʼ aʼan. Abʼan laj Guehazi, li xmoos laj Eliseo, kiraj choʼq re li maatan.

Joʼkan naq laj Guehazi xko xtawbʼal chaq laj Naaman ut kixye re: ‹Xinxtaqla chaq laj Eliseo re naq taakʼe wiibʼ oxibʼ rehebʼ laamaatan xbʼaan naq keʼwulak rulaʼ›. Moko yaal ta li kixye laj Guehazi. Abʼan laj Naaman inkʼaʼ naxnaw naq laj Guehazi yook chi tikʼtiʼik chiru joʼkan naq kixkʼe joʼnimal li kipatzʼeʼk re.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Eliseo li kixbʼaanu laj Guehazi. Joʼkan naq laj Eliseo kixye re: ‹Kʼaʼut xatmaakobʼk? Anaqwan li xsaqlep laj Naaman txik saʼ aabʼeen›. Tojaʼ naq kinujak chi saqlep laj Guehazi.

Kʼaru naqatzol chirix aʼin? Naqatzol naq tento tooʼaatinaq chirix li Jehobʼa joʼ kixbʼaanu li chʼina ixqaʼal. Xbʼaan naq aʼin naru naxtenqʼahebʼ li qas qiitzʼin. Xkabʼ, naq inkʼaʼ tqaqʼetqʼeeti qibʼ joʼ kixbʼaanu laj Naaman. Tento naq tooʼabʼinq chiruhebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru li Yos. Ut li rox, inkʼaʼ tootikʼtiʼiq joʼ kixbʼaanu laj Guehazi. Naabʼal li naʼlebʼ naxkʼe qe li Santil Hu, peʼyaal?2 Reyes 5:1-27. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW ani li winq wank saʼ li haʼ? Li winq aʼin aj Jonas ut ok re chi nuqʼeʼk xbʼaan li kar. Qatzolaq kʼaʼut naq wank saʼ chʼaʼajkilal laj Jonas.

Laj Jonas aj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa. Ak kikamk laj Eliseo naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Jonas: ‹Ayu saʼ li tenamit Ninive xbʼaan naq yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal. Ut tat-aatinaq chirix li xmaaʼusilalebʼ›.

Abʼan laj Jonas inkʼaʼ naraj xik saʼ li tenamit Ninive. Joʼkan naq xko saʼ jun li jukubʼ saʼ jalan chik naʼaj, najt chiru Ninive. Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kiwulak chiru naq laj Jonas kiʼelelik chiru, joʼkan naq kixtaqla jun li nimla kaqsut-iqʼ. Ut xbʼaan xkawil li kaqsut-iqʼ kibʼalqʼu raj li jukubʼ bʼarwiʼ yookebʼ wiʼ chi xik. Ebʼ li yookebʼ xchʼeebʼal li jukubʼ keʼok chi tijok chiruhebʼ li xpechʼbʼil yos re naq teʼkoleʼq. Tojaʼ naq laj Jonas kixye rehebʼ: ‹Laaʼin ninloqʼoni li Jehobʼa, li kiyiibʼank re li choxa ut li Ruuchichʼochʼ. Inkʼaʼ xinbʼaanu li xinxtaqla chi xbʼaanunkil›. Joʼkan naq ebʼ li yookebʼ xchʼeebʼal li jukubʼ keʼxye re laj Jonas: ‹Kʼaru tento tqabʼaanu aawe re naq ttuqlaaq ru li palaw?›

Laj Jonas kixye rehebʼ: ‹Kutumaqin saʼ li palaw›. Ebʼ li yookebʼ xchʼeebʼal li jukubʼ inkʼaʼ keʼraj xbʼaanunkil, abʼan naq kinimank xkawil roq li kaqsut-iqʼ, keʼxkut laj Jonas saʼ haʼ. Chirix chik aʼan kituqlaak li palaw.

Naq laj Jonas xko rubʼel haʼ, jun li nimla kar kinuqʼuk re. Abʼan inkʼaʼ kikamk ut kiwank saʼ xsaʼ li kar chiru oxibʼ kutan ut oxibʼ qʼoqyink. Laj Jonas kiyotʼeʼk xchʼool naq inkʼaʼ kiʼabʼink chiru li Jehobʼa ut naq inkʼaʼ xko saʼ li tenamit Ninive. Joʼkan naq, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu?

Laj Jonas kitijok chiru li Jehobʼa re naq ttenqʼaaq. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq li kar tixxawa laj Jonas chiru chʼochʼ. Chirix chik aʼan laj Jonas xko saʼ li tenamit Ninive. Chixjunil aʼin naxkʼut chiqu naq tento tooʼabʼinq chiru li Jehobʼa.Li tasal hu Jonás 1-4. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Li Naʼajej li Naxyeechiʼi li Yos
data.contenido:
MA NAKAAWIL li sahilal naʼajej? Aʼin tana li naʼajej kixkʼut li Jehobʼa chiru laj Isaias. Laj Isaias aj kʼanjel chiru li Yos. Maaʼani chik laj Jonas naq kiwank laj Isaias.

Kʼajoʼ xchʼinaʼusal li naʼajej aʼin! Kʼaru nachalk saʼ aachʼool naq nakaawil li naʼajej aʼin? Li sahilal naʼajej, li kixkʼe li Yos re laj Adan ut xʼEva. Abʼan, ma tchʼinaʼusoʼq tawiʼ chixjunil li Ruuchichʼochʼ?

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Isaias naq tixtzʼiibʼa chanruhaq li akʼ Ruuchichʼochʼ li tixkʼe li Yos re li xtenamit. Li Yos kixye re laj Isaias: ‹Li xojbʼ ut li karneer teʼwanq saʼ tuqtuukilal. Li saaj wakax ut li kaqkoj junaj teʼichajibʼq ut jun chʼinaʼal t-iloq rehebʼ. Maakʼaʼ tixkʼul li kʼuulaʼal naq tbʼatzʼunq chi xkʼatq li kʼantiʼ›.

Wankebʼ naru teʼxye naq aʼin maajunwa tkʼulmanq. Xbʼaan naq junelik wank li rahilal ut li chʼaʼajkilal. Abʼan kʼoxlan chirix aʼin, chanru li naʼajej kixkʼe li Yos re laj Adan ut xʼEva?

Li Yos kixkʼe laj Adan ut xʼEva saʼ jun chʼinaʼusil naʼajej, abʼan keʼxsach xbʼaan naq keʼxqʼet Raatin li Yos. Joʼkan naq keʼcheekobʼk ut keʼkamk. Li Yos naxyeechiʼi rehebʼ li nekeʼrahok re, jun li chʼinaʼusil naʼaj joʼ li kixkʼe re laj Adan ut li xʼEva.

Saʼ li akʼ Ruuchichʼochʼ maaʼani chik trahobʼtesinq, chi moko tixbʼaanu ta li maaʼusilal. Twanq tuqtuukilal. Ebʼ li qas qiitzʼin sahaqebʼ saʼ xchʼool ut maaʼani chik tyajerq joʼ kiwank chaq saʼ xtiklajik. Moqon chik tqatzol chanru tixchʼinaʼusa li Yos chixjunil li Ruuchichʼochʼ.Isaías 11:6-9; Apocalipsis 21:3, 4. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW kʼaʼut yook chi tijok li winq aʼin? Kʼaʼut naq kixkʼe ebʼ li hu chiru li Jehobʼa? Li winq aj Ezequias ut awabʼej re li wiibʼ chi teep re li tenamit Israel. Laj Ezequias wank saʼ chʼaʼajkilal. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut?

Xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj puubʼ re Asiria keʼxsach 10 xteepal li tenamit Israel. Li Jehobʼa kixkanabʼ naq teʼxkʼul chixjunil aʼin, xbʼaan naq maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Ebʼ laj puubʼ aʼin, keʼchalk ajwiʼ chi xsachbʼal li wiibʼ chi teep li naxjolomi laj Ezequias.

Li awabʼej re li tenamit Asiria, kixtaqla ebʼ li esil hu choʼq re laj Ezequias. Naq laj Ezequias kixkʼul ebʼ li esil hu kixkʼe chiru li Yos. Chisaʼ ebʼ li hu li awabʼej re Asiria kixmaajewa li Jehobʼa ut kixtaqla xyeebʼal re laj Ezequias naq tixqʼaxtesi ribʼ saʼ ruqʼ. Joʼkan naq, laj Ezequias kitijok chiru li Jehobʼa ut kixye re: ‹At Jehobʼa chooʼaakol chiru li awabʼej re Asiria, ut chi joʼkan chixjunilebʼ li tenamit teʼnawoq re naq kaʼajwiʼ laaʼat li tzʼaqal Yos›. Ma kirabʼi li Jehobʼa li xtij laj Ezequias?

Laj Ezequias chaabʼil awabʼej. Moko maaʼus ta xnaʼlebʼ joʼebʼ li awabʼej re li 10 chi teep re li tenamit Israel. Chi moko kixkʼam ta re rikʼin laj Acaz, li xyuwaʼ. Laj Ezequias kixpaabʼ chixjunil li xchaqʼrabʼ li Jehobʼa. Naq laj Ezequias kiraqeʼk chi tijok, li Jehobʼa kixtaqla laj Isaias chi xyeebʼal re aʼin: ‹Li awabʼej re Asiria inkʼaʼ t-oq saʼ li tenamit aʼin, chi moko tixkut ta junaq ral simaj ut maajun rehebʼ laj puubʼ t-oq saʼ li tenamit›. Ma nakaanaw anihebʼ li kamenaq li wankebʼ saʼ li eetalil? Aʼanebʼ laj puubʼ re li tenamit Asiria. Li Jehobʼa kixtaqla jun li xʼanjel ut chiru jun qʼoqyink ajwiʼ kixkamsihebʼ 185.000 aj puubʼ. Joʼkan naq li awabʼej re Asiria kisutqʼiik saʼ li tenamit Ninive.

Ebʼ li poyanam li wankebʼ saʼ li wiibʼ chi teep li naxjolomi laj Ezequias, keʼkoleʼk ut keʼwank saʼ tuqtuukilal. Naq kikamk laj Ezequias, laj Manases kikanaak choʼq awabʼej. Laj Manases ralal laj Ezequias. Laj Amon ralal laj Manases. Laj Amon ut laj Manases, maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ ut keʼwank choʼq awabʼej. Joʼkan naq saʼ li tenamit Israel kinumtaak li kamsink ut li rahilal. Naq laj Amon kikamsiik xbʼaanebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru; laj Josias, li ralal, kikanaak choʼq awabʼej saʼ xbʼeen li wiibʼ chi teep re li tenamit Israel.2 Reyes 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

WAQXAQIBʼ chihabʼ wank re laj Josias naq kiʼok chi awabʼejink saʼ wiibʼ li teep re Israel. Toj kachʼin laj Josias, joʼkan naq wankebʼ winq keʼtenqʼank re chi jolomink.

Ak wuqubʼ chihabʼ rokik laj Josias chi awabʼejink naq kiʼok chi xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa. Kixkʼam re rikʼin laj David, laj Jehosafat ut rikʼin laj Ezequias. Toj saaj naq kixbʼaanu jun li chaabʼil naʼlebʼ.

Chiru naabʼal chihabʼ, naabʼalebʼ laj Israel maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Keʼxloqʼoni ut keʼxwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiruhebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos. Joʼkan naq laj Josias ut ebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru, keʼok xsachbʼal li bʼalaqʼil paabʼal. Li kʼanjel aʼin chʼaʼaj xbʼaanunkil xbʼaan naq, naabʼalebʼ keʼloqʼonink re li pechʼbʼil yos. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk chanru yookebʼ xpukʼinkil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos.

Chirix chik aʼan laj Josias kixaqabʼ oxibʼ chi winq re naq teʼxyiibʼ li Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Keʼxchʼutubʼ chixjunil li tumin re li tenamit, re xtojbʼalebʼ laj kʼanjel. Naq ebʼ li winq aʼin, yookebʼ chi kʼanjelak saʼ li Rochoch li Yos; laj Hilquias, xbʼeenil aj tij, kixtaw xhuhil li chaqʼrabʼ li kikʼeheʼk re laj Moises saʼ li qʼe kutan. Li chaqʼrabʼ aʼin kisachk.

Naq keʼxkʼam li chaqʼrabʼ re laj Josias, kiraj xnawbʼal kʼaru naxye. Tojaʼ naq laj Josias kixkʼe reetal naq li tenamit moko yook ta xyuʼaminkil li xchaqʼrabʼ li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool ut kixpej li raqʼ joʼ nakaawil saʼ li eetalil. Chirix chik aʼan kixye: ‹Li Jehobʼa yook xjosqʼil qikʼin, xbʼaan naq ebʼ li qanaʼ qayuwaʼ inkʼaʼ keʼxyuʼami li xchaqʼrabʼ›. Laj Josias kixtaqla laj Hilquias rikʼin xHulda, jun li ixq aj kʼanjel chiru li Yos, re xpatzʼbʼal re kʼaru tixbʼaanu li Jehobʼa rikʼin li tenamit. Li xHulda kixye re laj Hilquias kʼaru kixye li Yos: ‹Li tenamit Jerusalen ut chixjunilebʼ li wankebʼ aran tinkʼe xtojbʼalebʼ xmaak. Xbʼaan naq keʼxloqʼoni ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos ut li Ruuchichʼochʼ kinujak saʼ maaʼusilal. Abʼan li rahilal aʼin inkʼaʼ tchalq naq toj yoʼyooq laj Josias, xbʼaan naq yook xbʼaanunkil li us›.2 Crónicas 34:1-28. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

ANI li winq yookebʼ xseʼenkil? Aʼan laj Jeremias ut aj kʼanjel chiru li Jehobʼa. Laj Jeremias yook xkʼeebʼal jun nimla esil rehebʼ laj Israel.

Laj Josias ak kixsach chixjunil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos saʼ li tenamit Jerusalen, naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Jeremias naq tkanaaq choʼq aj kʼanjel chiru. Laj Jeremias kixkʼoxla naq inkʼaʼ truuq kʼanjelak chiru li Jehobʼa xbʼaan naq toj saaj. Abʼan li Jehobʼa kixyeechiʼi xtenqʼankil.

Laj Jeremias kixye rehebʼ laj Israel naq teʼxkanabʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal. Tojaʼ naq kixye rehebʼ: ‹Ebʼ li tenamit yookebʼ xloqʼoninkil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos›. Naabʼalebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ chik nekeʼraj xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa. Laj Jeremias kixye re li tenamit naq li Jehobʼa traqoq aatin saʼ xbʼeenebʼ. Naq keʼrabʼi aʼin, keʼok xseʼenkil.

Chirix chik aʼan kikamk laj Josias. Oxibʼ po xkamik laj Josias naq laj Joaquim, li ralal, kikanaak choʼq awabʼej. Laj Jeremias kixye rehebʼ laj Israel: ‹Li tenamit Jerusalen tsachmanq wi inkʼaʼ nekeejal leenaʼlebʼ›. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj tij keʼxchap laj Jeremias ut keʼxye: ‹Tento naq tkamq laj Jeremias xbʼaan naq xmaajewa li qatenamit!›

Kʼaru tixbʼaanu laj Jeremias xbʼaan naq teʼraj xkamsinkil? Laj Jeremias inkʼaʼ naxuwak chiru li tenamit, joʼkan naq kixye rehebʼ: ‹Li Jehobʼa kitaqlank chaq we eerikʼin ut wi inkʼaʼ nekeejal leenaʼlebʼ, traqoq aatin saʼ xbʼeen leetenamit Jerusalen. Wi tineekamsi, laaʼex nekeenaw naq maakʼaʼ inmaak cheeru›.

Ebʼ li nekeʼjolomink saʼ li tenamit inkʼaʼ keʼxkamsi laj Jeremias, abʼan ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ keʼxkanabʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal. Chirix chik aʼan; laj Nabucodonosor, li awabʼej re Babilonia, kichalk chi yalok saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Jerusalen. Tojaʼ naq laj Nabucodonosor kixkʼehebʼ laj Israel choʼq xmoos. Naabʼalebʼ xkʼihal laj Israel kixkʼam saʼ li tenamit Babilonia. Kʼaru taakʼoxla naq jun chʼuut chi winq tateʼxkʼam raj saʼ jalan chik tenamit?Jeremías 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Reyes 24:1-17. data.titulo: Laj Daniel ut Ebʼ li Ramiiw
data.contenido:
LAJ Nabucodonosor, li awabʼej, kixkʼamebʼ saʼ li tenamit Babilonia ebʼ laj Israel li wankebʼ xtzolom. Chirix chik aʼan kixsikʼebʼ ru ebʼ li saaj al li chʼinaʼusebʼ rilbʼal ut wankebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Saʼ li eetalil aʼin wankebʼ li saaj al li kixsikʼebʼ ru. Jun rehebʼ li saaj al aʼan laj Daniel. Ebʼ laj Babilonia keʼxkʼe li xkʼabʼaʼebʼ li oxibʼ chi ramiiw laj Daniel ut aʼanebʼ: laj Sadrac, laj Mesac ut laj Abednego.

Laj Nabucodonosor kiraj xkʼeebʼal xtzolbʼal ebʼ li saaj al, re naq teʼkʼanjelaq saʼ li rochoch. Ut naq tnumeʼq raj oxibʼ chihabʼ xtzolbʼalebʼ, kixsikʼ raj saʼ xyanqebʼ kaʼajwiʼ li wankebʼ xnaʼlebʼ chiʼus, re naq teʼxtaw xyaalal ebʼ li chʼaʼajkilal. Li awabʼej kixye naq ebʼ li saaj al, teʼrukʼ li bʼiin ut teʼxtzaka li naxwaʼ li awabʼej ut li xjunkabʼal, re naq wanqebʼ xmetzʼew.

Ma nakaanaw kʼaru yook xyeebʼal laj Daniel re laj Aspenaz, li xbʼeenil aj kʼanjel chiru laj Nabucodonosor? Laj Daniel kixye naq inkʼaʼ naraj xtzakankil li wank saʼ xmeex li awabʼej. Laj Aspenaz kiʼok xkʼaʼuxl naq kirabʼi aʼin, joʼkan naq kixye: ‹Li awabʼej kixye kʼaru tento teetzaka ut teerukʼ. Wi inkʼaʼ kawaqex joʼebʼ li junchʼol chi saaj al, naru tinxkamsi›.

Laj Aspenaz kixkanabʼ jun aj puubʼ re naq tixkʼaakʼale laj Daniel ut ebʼ li ramiiw. Laj Daniel kixye re laj puubʼ: ‹Yal xkʼeebʼal qe chiru 10 kutan ru li awimq, li ichaj ut li haʼ. Tojaʼ naq tooʼaajuntaqʼeeta rikʼinebʼ li keʼxwa li xtzakahemq li awabʼej ut taakʼe reetal ani kaw ribʼ chiʼus›.

Laj puubʼ kixbʼaanu li kixye laj Daniel. Naq kinumeʼk li 10 kutan laj Daniel ut ebʼ li oxibʼ chi ramiiw jwal kawebʼ ribʼ chiruhebʼ li junchʼol chi saaj al. Joʼkan naq inkʼaʼ chik keʼkʼeheʼk re li tzakahemq li kixye li awabʼej.

Naq kiwulak oxibʼ chihabʼ chixjunilebʼ li saaj al keʼkʼameʼk rikʼin laj Nabucodonosor ut li awabʼej kiʼaatinak rikʼinebʼ. Tojaʼ naq kixkʼe reetal naq laj Daniel ut ebʼ li oxibʼ chi ramiiw jwal wankebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Joʼkan naq keʼok chi kʼanjelak saʼ li rochoch li awabʼej. Naq li awabʼej wank saʼ chʼaʼajkilal nachalk rikʼinebʼ laj Daniel, laj Sadrac, laj Mesac ut laj Abednego re naq teʼxchʼolobʼ li chʼaʼajkilal. Laj Daniel ut ebʼ li ramiiw jwal wankebʼ xnawom, joʼkan naq 10 sut keʼxqʼax xnaʼlebʼ laj tij ut ebʼ laj qʼe.Daniel 1:1-21. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

AK XNUMEʼK 10 chihabʼ naq laj Nabucodonosor kixkʼamebʼ li wankebʼ xnaʼlebʼ saʼ li tenamit Babilonia. Li tenamit Jerusalen kikʼatk. Abʼan ebʼ laj Israel li inkʼaʼ keʼkamk, keʼkʼameʼk choʼq moos saʼ li tenamit Babilonia.

Ebʼ laj kʼanjel chiru li Yos keʼxye naq chixjunil aʼin teʼxkʼul ebʼ laj Israel wi inkʼaʼ nekeʼxjal xnaʼlebʼ. Abʼan ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ keʼabʼink ut inkʼaʼ keʼxkanabʼ xloqʼoninkil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos. Laj Ezequiel, laj kʼanjel chiru li Yos, kixye chixjunil li maaʼusilal li keʼxbʼaanu ebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq xkʼulubʼebʼ chixjunil aʼin.

Ma nakaanaw ani laj Ezequiel? Aʼan jun rehebʼ li saaj al li kixkʼam laj Nabucodonosor saʼ li tenamit Babilonia naq toj maajiʼ nekeʼxsach li tenamit Jerusalen. Naq kikʼameʼk laj Ezequiel, keʼkʼameʼk ajwiʼ laj Daniel ut ebʼ li oxibʼ chi ramiiw.

Laj Ezequiel toj wank saʼ li tenamit Babilonia naq li Jehobʼa kixkʼut chiru rikʼin sachbʼachʼoolej li maaʼusilal li yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil saʼ li Rochoch li Yos aran Jerusalen. Kʼajoʼ xyiibʼal ru li kiril laj Ezequiel saʼ li sachbʼachʼoolej!

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Ezequiel: ‹Chaawil ebʼ laj Israel yookebʼ xtzʼajninkil saʼ li Wochoch. Xeʼxkʼe reetalil ebʼ li kʼantiʼ ut ebʼ li xul chiru li tzʼak. Ut yookebʼ xloqʼoninkilebʼ ru!› Laj Ezequiel kiril chixjunil li kiyeheʼk re xbʼaan li Yos ut kixtzʼiibʼa li yook chi kʼulmank.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Ezequiel: ‹Ma nakaawil kʼaru yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil saʼ muqmu ebʼ li nekeʼkʼamok bʼe saʼ Israel?› Laj Ezequiel kiril ebʼ li 70 chi winq li yookebʼ xloqʼoninkil ebʼ li pechʼbʼil yos. Ut yookebʼ xyeebʼal: ‹Li Jehobʼa maaʼani chik saʼ li tenamit, joʼkan naq inkʼaʼ nokooril›.

Li Jehobʼa kixkʼut chiru laj Ezequiel naq chunchuukebʼ wiibʼ oxibʼ li ixq saʼ rokebʼaal li ochoch re loqʼonink ut yookebʼ xloqʼoninkil li pechʼbʼil yos Tamuz. Saʼ li xnim ruqʼebʼ li ixq wankebʼ tana 25 chi winq li yookebʼ chi xloqʼoninkil li Saqʼe.

Tojaʼ naq li Jehobʼa kixye: ‹Ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ nekeʼroxloqʼi wu. Yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal ut yookebʼ ajwiʼ xbʼaanunkil saʼ li Wochoch. Joʼkan naq teʼxyal xkawil injosqʼil. Ut inkʼaʼ twil xtoqʼobʼaal ruhebʼ naq tinsachebʼ›. Ak oxibʼ chihabʼ xnumik li eetalil li kixkʼut li Jehobʼa chiru laj Ezequiel, naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxqʼet ribʼ chiru laj Nabucodonosor. Joʼkan naq laj Nabucodonosor kichalk chi yalok saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel. Naq kinumeʼk jun chihabʼ rikʼin waqibʼ po, ebʼ laj Babilonia keʼxtʼan li tzʼak ut keʼxkʼat li tenamit Jerusalen. Naabʼal keʼkamk ut wank keʼkʼameʼk choʼq moos saʼ li tenamit Babilonia.

Kʼaʼut naq li Jehobʼa kixkanabʼ naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼxkʼul li rahilal aʼin? Ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ keʼrabʼi li Jehobʼa chi moko keʼxpaabʼ ta li xchaqʼrabʼ. Aʼin naxkʼut chiqu naq junelik tqabʼaanu li naxye qe li Yos.

Laj Nabucodonosor kixbʼaanu naq jun chʼuut chi poyanam teʼkanaaq saʼ li tenamit Israel. Ut kixxaqabʼ laj Guedalias, jun laj Judiiy, re naq t-iloq rehebʼ. Abʼan wiibʼ oxibʼ rehebʼ laj Israel keʼxkamsi laj Guedalias. Naq keʼxbʼaanu aʼin ebʼ laj Israel keʼok xxiw xbʼaan naq naru teʼkamsiiq xbʼaanebʼ laj Babilonia. Joʼkan naq keʼelelik ut keʼxkʼam laj Jeremias chirixebʼ saʼ li tenamit Egipto.

Joʼkan naq chiru 70 chihabʼ maaʼani chik kiwank saʼ li tenamit Israel. Li Jehobʼa kixye naq tnumeʼq 70 chihabʼ re naq teʼsutqʼiiq chaq ebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Jerusalen. Kʼaru yookebʼ xkʼulbʼal ebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Babilonia?2 Reyes 25:1-26; Jeremías 29:10; Ezequiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru
